status: Both focused native experiment jobs passed; production acceptance of the selected change is separate.
comparison: Identical checked-ARC generated C with compiler-selected inlining versus a noinline attribute on the existing native fwp_rc_share check. No check is removed.

inputs.loop: 100 million updates of a pair of integers
inputs.map: 500000 sorted pairs and two million lookups

flags.native_c: clang -O2 -std=gnu11 -ffp-contract=off -w, ordinary runtime and TLS/float links selected by compile_c; no LTO with this Clang

timing_scope: One warmup, six fresh whole-process runs per variant, alternating order. Startup, allocation, computation, printing and shutdown included; compilation excluded. C outputs must match; C/Rust are not timed here.
memory_scope: No allocation, live-memory or RSS counters in this arrangement experiment. Separate counted binaries measure logical check entries through cached-value cleanup. Instrumentation can prevent elimination/inlining; counts do not establish ordinary machine-call frequency.
selection: Keep one noinline copy of the existing native ARC check to reduce code size. Tracing mode is unchanged. No speedup or zero-cost claim.
limits: Two Linux hosts, one batch per host; shared-runner noise limits timing conclusions. HTTP variants are compiled, not executed in this experiment. Separate functional/memory suites and all final-head gates remain required.
